title: Todd Monken says Browns' QBs threw "embarrassing" interceptions at OTAs

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Todd Monken says Browns' QBs threw "embarrassing" interceptions at OTAs
sources.description: “We threw interceptions in 7-on-7 for God’s sakes. Who does that? There’s no pass rush. I mean, it was embarrassing,” Monken said.
